recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-34156 unless a future PA decision changes the Patient.link/RelatedPerson model.
issue_request: FHIR-34156 asked PA to resolve the mismatch where Patient.link.other.short mentioned RelatedPerson but the definition still said only the other patient resource; the Published/Persuasive resolution approved the definition "Link to a Patient or RelatedPerson resource that concerns the same actual individual."
initial_application: Git commit 00eacab651795cde741170aa227fe10d72b761d6 applied the issue by changing source/patient/structuredefinition-Patient.xml from the old Patient-only definition to the approved Patient-or-RelatedPerson wording.
additional_context: Patient is active in source/fhir.ini. Earlier Published issues FHIR-23009 and FHIR-32874 established and corrected the RelatedPerson-inclusive Patient.link wording; FHIR-34329 later changed "person" to "individual" and is already represented on the combined branch; FHIR-41559 later clarified RelatedPerson after a Patient.link implementer question rather than reversing this model.
reconciliation: No source change was made because current source/patient/structuredefinition-Patient.xml has Patient.link.other.definition exactly as approved and lists both Patient and RelatedPerson target profiles.
